acceptanceCriteria.text: Init uses the shared/canonical flag parser rather than independently parsing the same public options.
`--foo value` and `--foo=value` behave identically for every affected value option.
Missing values, duplicate/conflicting values, and unknown/unconsumed arguments fail closed with bounded diagnostics.
Regression tests cover `--workspace`, `--config`, `--scope`, `--client`, and `--import` in inline and separate-token forms.
Packed-package smoke coverage includes at least one inline-value init invocation.

issue.title: fix: parse init inline option values consistently
